plain_english: How is the supreme sacrifice, and who is here in this body, O Madhusūdana? At the time of departure, how are you knowable by those of controlled selves? They know Brahman and so forth. By such questions raised by the Lord, preceded by nine questions, the matter is determined. The remainder is: how does the supreme sacrifice stand in the body?
